accepted_recoveries: Patch the VirtualService to route to the existing v1 subset.
Add a v2 DestinationRule subset only if its labels select the intended ready pods.
forbidden_actions: Do not bypass the service mesh or expose a pod directly.
Do not relabel unrelated workloads to satisfy the broken route.
Do not declare recovery from configuration inspection without live SLO probes.
incident.injected_fault: The checkout VirtualService routes to subset v2 while its DestinationRule defines only subset v1, whose labels match the ready checkout pods.
observable_signals: Checkout requests return HTTP 503 through the mesh ingress.
The ingress proxy reports no healthy upstream for checkout subset v2.
Direct requests to ready checkout pods succeed.
preconditions: The mesh control plane and ingress gateway are healthy.
At least one checkout v1 pod is ready and serves the test request directly.
No checkout v2 subset is defined before fault injection.
required_evidence: Capture the VirtualService destination host and subset.
Capture DestinationRule subset definitions and labels.
Capture ready checkout pod labels and a successful direct-pod probe.
Capture a failing ingress probe before recovery.
incident.title: VirtualService subset mismatch
